move.text:
Dear partner,
Many thanks for your reply; we really appreciate the chance to work with you.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your feedback regarding our delivery performance and are committed to continuous improvement.
We are pleased to accept the 42-day lead time; however, to maintain our competitive cost structure, we must request keeping the payment terms at 45 days.
With these terms, we can revise our price to EUR 15.20 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €15.20 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
